description: Analyze costs, debt, repayment progress, and earnings for one school. Returns debt-to-earnings and net-price-to-annual-earnings ratios alongside the source figures. family_income selects the applicable net-price bracket. Repayment progress is the share of borrowers paying down principal 3 years after entering repayment.

family_income.description: Annual family income in dollars. When provided, net price is shown for the applicable income bracket.

anyOf.description: Base-10 school ID resolving to a positive safe integer; whitespace, leading zeros, plus, decimal, and exponent forms are accepted.

name: scorecard_value_analysis

applicable_income_bracket.description: Requested income bracket, retained even when its estimate is unavailable.

data_notes.description: Flags for suppressed, missing, or potentially unreliable data fields. Empty when all data is available.

debt_to_earnings_ratio.description: Debt-to-earnings ratio: median_debt / earnings_6yr_median. Values >1 indicate debt exceeds annual earnings.

effective_net_price.description: Price used in the annual-earnings ratio: available income bracket, otherwise overall net price.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `school_not_found`: No school record found for the requested ID. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

family_income.description: Requested annual family income in dollars.

list_price.description: Full tuition and fees (in-state, or out-of-state when no in-state exists).

net_price_basis.description: Source of the effective price; unavailable means no estimate exists.

net_price_for_income.description: Net price for the provided family income bracket. Omitted when family_income not provided.

net_price_overall.description: Average net price across all income levels.

net_price_to_annual_earnings.description: Net price divided by median annual earnings measured 6 years after entry. Uses the family-income net price when available, otherwise the overall net price.

repayment_progress_3yr.description: Share of borrowers paying down principal (declining loan balance) 3 years after entering repayment (0–1).

title: Value Analysis
